The '''Corweillian sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]], [[Hevvrol sector/Legends|Hevvrol sector]], [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]], [[Paqwepori]] sector, [[Primtara sector/Legends|Primtara sector]] and the [[Xan sector/Legends|Xan sector]].
